title: We built an AI game development studio with a crew of 5 specialized agents. Here’s what it can do!
author: Plastic_Bag6171
selftext:
Hey everyone!

We’ve been building **Engine Forge**, an AI powered game development studio where you work with a crew of specialized agents instead of a single coding assistant.

Meet the crew:  
**Maestro:** Planning and coordination  
**Builder:** Game world development  
**Systems Smith:** Game systems and UI  
**Juicer:** Visual polish and game feel  
**Playtester:** Testing and feedback

One of our biggest technical challenges was making AI agents work with actual game engines, rather than just generating code.

We built managed game engine support, so Engine Forge can handle downloading, setting up, and managing supported engines.

The result is a workspace where you can go from an idea to an actual playable game using Godot or Unity.

Our paid beta is now live!  
I’ve attached a short video showing what we’ve built.  
I’m part of the team behind Engine Forge, and I’d love to hear your feedback!  
[https://engineforge.ai/](https://engineforge.ai/)
